doc: the community floor for deployment events — the stratum the design document's worked example stands on.

refs.name: SubjectRef
refs.doc: addresses the subject a deployment event is about.

refs.name: ArtifactRef
refs.doc: addresses a deployable artifact in the record.

refs.name: EnvironmentRef
refs.doc: addresses an environment a deployment targets.

types.name: DeploymentFinished
types.doc: is a deployment that reached a terminal state — either outcome. The resolved idiom delivers the completed thought and the body branches; the declaration never filters.

types.name: DeploymentRecorded
types.doc: says a deployment was taken into the record. Emitting it IS the storage action; there is no separate write.

types.name: Deploy
types.doc: asks for an artifact to be put on an environment. It is speech: whoever declared comprehension of it will hear it, and nobody else will.

deliveries.name: ResolvedDelivery
deliveries.doc: is what a station awaiting the completed deployment thought is constructed with.

verbs.name: History
verbs.doc: opens the seat that answers from the record. History is just another awaited shape: every past emission was already a write, so there is no query surface and no second convention.

intents.name: Last
intents.doc: asks the record for the most recent deployment that ended with the given outcome.

verbs.name: Ledger
verbs.doc: opens the seat that keeps the deployment ledger.

intents.name: Note
intents.doc: asks the ledger to carry a note beside the deployment.
